items.name: humanish-tokens
items.title: humanish tokens
items.description: The humanish.dev token system: paper/ink mineral palette, ultramarine accent, dark-zone tokens, shadows, and type stacks. Light by default; dark via prefers-color-scheme or data-theme="dark" on <html>. Import the stylesheet in your global CSS.
items.docs: Import in your global stylesheet: @import "../styles/humanish/humanish-tokens.css"; — tokens are plain CSS custom properties on :root (plus a Tailwind v4 @theme block), so they work with or without Tailwind. Wire --font-newsreader / --font-geist / --font-geist-mono (e.g. via next/font) or the type stacks fall back to system faces.

items.name: terminal-cast
items.title: Terminal cast
items.description: A static terminal transcript rendered as text — command, check lines, and a ruled summary. Copy-pastable, no pixels. The component humanish.dev uses for its verify output.
items.docs: Import styles once in your global CSS: @import "../styles/humanish/terminal-cast.css";. Renders light-on-dark: place inside a dark surface (e.g. the pinned-replay dark panel, or your own). Example: <TerminalCast lines={[{ kind: "cmd", text: "$ humanish verify" }, { kind: "ok", text: "redaction passed" }, { kind: "sum", text: "16/16 passed" }]} />

items.name: persona-lane
items.title: Persona lane
items.description: One lane of a run: the keyframe a persona saw, its verbatim final report, and an honest status chip — failed lanes render muted, never hidden. Ships the resolve-cover canvas veil that dissolves into the screenshot (finished state under reduced motion).
items.docs: Import styles once in your global CSS: @import "../styles/humanish/persona-lane.css";. Example: <PersonaLane idx="01" name="sticky-notes" img="/lane.jpg" alt="…" reportLabel="Final report — verbatim" report="Done." passed />

items.name: pinned-replay
items.title: Pinned replay
items.description: The scroll-pinned run walkthrough from humanish.dev: a tall track pins a step rail and stage; scroll advances discrete panels (brief, lanes, evidence ledger, verify terminal) with an idle-snap that centers the nearest step. Below 1024px — or without JavaScript — panels stack as a readable list. Ships with the Excalidraw study as demo data; replace the constants at the top with your own run.
items.docs: Import styles once in your global CSS: @import "../styles/humanish/pinned-replay.css"; (persona-lane and terminal-cast styles install alongside). The demo data constants (BRIEF_YAML, RAIL_ITEMS, LANES, VERIFY_CAST) are yours to replace; the scroll engine reads panels from the DOM, so add or remove panels freely. Respects prefers-reduced-motion.
